SELECT COUNT(OI.outReqItemsId) FROM outboundItems OI INNER JOIN outboundRequest OBR ON OI.outReqId = OBR.outReqId WHERE (OBR.IsDelete IS NULL OR OBR.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.status = '승인완료'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(II.inDttmRecv, '%Y-%m-%d') AS chart_key, SUM(II.inQty) AS total_quantity FROM inboundItems II INNER JOIN inboundRequests IR ON II.inReqId = IR.inReqId WHERE II.status = '입고완료' AND (IR.IsDelete IS NULL OR IR.IsDelete = 0) AND II.inDttmRecv >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY chart_key ORDER BY chart_key ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(OI.outDttmShip, '%Y-%m-%d') AS chart_key, SUM(OI.outQtyReq) AS total_quantity FROM outboundItems OI INNER JOIN outboundRequest OBR ON OI.outReqId = OBR.outReqId WHERE OI.status = '출고완료' AND (OBR.IsDelete IS NULL OR OBR.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.outDttmShip >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY chart_key ORDER BY chart_key ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(II.inDttmRecv, '%Y-%m') AS chart_key, SUM(II.inQty) AS total_quantity FROM inboundItems II INNER JOIN inboundRequests IR ON II.inReqId = IR.inReqId WHERE II.status = '입고완료' AND (IR.IsDelete IS NULL OR IR.IsDelete = 0) AND II.inDttmRecv >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY chart_key ORDER BY chart_key ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(OI.outDttmShip, '%Y-%m') AS chart_key, SUM(OI.outQtyReq) AS total_quantity FROM outboundItems OI INNER JOIN outboundRequest OBR ON OI.outReqId = OBR.outReqId WHERE OI.status = '출고완료' AND (OBR.IsDelete IS NULL OR OBR.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.outDttmShip >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY chart_key ORDER BY chart_key ASC

mapper.select: SELECT C.cfName, SUM(II.inQty) AS total_quantity FROM inboundItems II INNER JOIN inboundRequests IR ON II.inReqId = IR.inReqId INNER JOIN coffee C ON II.cfId = C.cfId WHERE II.status = '입고완료' AND (IR.IsDelete IS NULL OR IR.IsDelete = 0) AND II.inDttmRecv >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY C.cfId, C.cfName ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT C.cfName, SUM(OI.outQtyReq) AS total_quantity FROM outboundItems II INNER JOIN outboundRequest OBR ON OI.outReqId = OBR.outReqId INNER JOIN stock S ON OI.stkId = S.stkId INNER JOIN coffee C ON S.cfId = C.cfId WHERE OI.status = '출고완료' AND (OBR.IsDelete IS NULL OR OBR.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.outDttmShip >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY C.cfId, C.cfName ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, OBR.outDttmReq, OI.outDttmShip)) FROM outboundItems OI INNER JOIN outboundRequest OBR ON OI.outReqId = OBR.outReqId WHERE OI.status = '출고완료' AND (OBR.IsDelete IS NULL OR OBR.IsDelete = 0) AND OI.outDttmShip >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

SELECT W.whName, LP.zoneName FROM warehouse W -- 창고에 속한 모든 Zone 정보를 가져오기 위한 조인 INNER JOIN locations L ON W.whId = L.whId INNER JOIN location_places LP ON L.lpId = LP.lpId WHERE -- 서브쿼리를 통해 특정 날짜에 필요 용량 이상을 수용할 수 있는 창고 ID만 필터링 W.whId IN ( SELECT whId FROM warehouseCapaSchedule WHERE dateId = #{targetDate} AND available_capacity >= #{requiredCapa} ) ORDER BY W.whName, LP.zoneName -- MyBatis가 결과를 올바르게 그룹핑하도록 정렬
